constructor.details: No setter can replace the arbitrator after funds are deposited.

params._arbitrator: Address trusted to decide disputed bounty payouts.
params._paymaster: Address authorized to relay approved releases.
params._token: Address of the USDC (or mock) ERC-20 token.

createBounty(address,uint256).details: Approve this vault for `amount` beforehand. The arbitrator cannot      be either party, and the protocol cannot name itself as whitehat.      Effects precede the token interaction; failure rolls everything back.

params.amount: The USDC deposit in token base units (6 decimals for USDC).
params.whitehat: The fixed beneficiary, permitted to dispute but not claim.

disputeBounty(uint256).details: Only the recorded whitehat may dispute. No token interaction occurs;      Disputed blocks normal payout until the immutable arbitrator acts.

getDeal(uint256).details: Unknown IDs return zero addresses, zero amount, and Status.None.

returns.amount: The original deposit, unchanged after payout for history.
returns.protocol: The depositor who approves normal payout.
returns.status: The current state, including terminal payout outcomes.

releaseBounty(uint256,uint256,address).details: The whitehat cannot self-release. The protocol's direct call ignores      supplied fee/recipient and pays the recorded whitehat in full. That      branch also wins if protocol and paymaster happen to be identical.      Judge note: sponsored protocol-account releases still call AS the      protocol account and therefore use this zero-fee branch. Sponsorship      is FREE; it does not make msg.sender the paymaster or collect USDC.      The relay branch checks recipient and bounds the fee; it is reserved      for a future relay calling AS the paymaster, which must preserve      protocol approval. Disputed and terminal bounties cannot be released.

params.fee: USDC reimbursement for the paymaster path only.
params.whitehat: Must match the recorded beneficiary on the relay path.

resolveDispute(uint256,bool).details: Only the immutable arbitrator may decide. There is no fee, split,      recipient override, or path to reopen a resolved bounty. The final      status is written before transferring the full deposit (CEI).

params.payWhitehat: True pays the whitehat; false refunds the protocol.

arbitrator().notice: Fixed at deployment: the one trusted party for disputes.

constructor.notice: Fix the asset, authorized relay, and neutral adjudicator.

createBounty(address,uint256).notice: Deposit USDC for a specific whitehat; the caller is the protocol.

deals(uint256).notice: All bounties, indexed by deal ID.

disputeBounty(uint256).notice: Freeze the caller's open bounty for neutral arbitration.

getDeal(uint256).notice: Read a bounty's participants, original amount, and lifecycle state.

paymaster().notice: Authorized payout relay; cannot decide dispute outcomes.

releaseBounty(uint256,uint256,address).notice: Approve and release an open bounty to its recorded whitehat.

resolveDispute(uint256,bool).notice: Resolve a disputed bounty entirely to one of its two parties.

token().notice: The ERC-20 token used for bounties (USDC or the mock).
